gloss: misunderstanding; crossing paths, missing each other

definitions.gloss: crossing paths, passing each other, missing each other
definitions.explanation: The physical act of passing by someone going in the opposite direction or failing to meet due to different timing.
A failure to understand each other correctly, often due to different expectations or assumptions.
